units: Axiom Forge Mk1 / RECA research benchmark repository.
Repository studies Recursive Environment-Coupled Adaptation (RECA): whether recursively changing adaptation can remain coupled to environmental consequences and improve future viability.
Core candidate relation is D_c * C_e * A_c -> G_V.
D_c denotes recursive depth: depth at which the system modifies mechanisms responsible for adaptation.
C_e denotes consequence coupling: degree to which adaptation remains coupled to environmental consequences.
A_c denotes adaptive consolidation: persistence/retention of useful adaptive changes across time.
G_V denotes generative/future viability: capacity to preserve or expand viable future adaptation after perturbation.
Source terminology is retained without forcing identity with similarly named constructs elsewhere.
Higher recursive depth alone is not proposed as sufficient; recursive change must remain consequence-coupled and consolidate adaptive structure to yield future viability.
Immediate reward/performance is distinguished from long-horizon viability and recovery after environmental change.
Ordinary adaptation within a mechanism is distinguished from structural/recursive modification of the adaptation mechanism itself.
Repository proposes baseline-versus-RECA comparison, perturbation and long-horizon evaluation to test future adaptive capability rather than only current score.
Repository is a proof-of-concept benchmark/research scaffold rather than a completed empirical validation.
A useful RECA claim must be falsifiable by future viability and perturbation behavior, not protected by terminology alone.
The multiplicative relation D_c*C_e*A_c -> G_V does not specify a causal functional form, scale compatibility, estimator, threshold or identification protocol.
Future viability and beneficial structural adaptation require operational definitions beyond the high-level README framing.
Default experiment name is reca_vs_baseline with seed 42 and 1000 steps.
Default environment is width 10, height 10, goal [9,9].
Default agent parameters are learning_rate 0.1, gamma 0.95 and epsilon 0.1.
Output configuration names results/ with raw and summary saving enabled.
Systems may improve current performance while failing to preserve the causal link between consequences and the mechanisms that generate future adaptation.
RECA is recursive adaptation in which environmental consequence information remains relevant to structural change and useful structural changes persist.
D_c is recursive depth of mechanism modification.
C_e is environmental consequence coupling to adaptive change.
A_c is adaptive consolidation/retention of useful structural change.
G_V is proposed future/generative viability outcome.
D_c * C_e * A_c -> G_V is proposed as a compact causal hypothesis rather than a demonstrated law.
Fixed optimization, ordinary adaptive learning, recursive self-modification and consequence-coupled recursive adaptation are treated as separable regimes.
RECA should show improved recovery and future viability after perturbations when structural changes are consequence-coupled and consolidated.
Theory is weakened if recursive/coupled/consolidated variables do not predict future viability beyond immediate performance or simpler adaptation variables.
Theory is framed as a testable benchmark hypothesis requiring empirical validation, not a completed general theory.
Theoretical D_c, C_e, A_c and G_V lack universally established scales and causal estimators in the theory document.
The arrow to G_V requires intervention/counterfactual semantics to distinguish causal contribution from correlation with capable systems.
Baseline agent adapts within a relatively fixed mechanism/parameterization and provides the non-recursive comparison condition.
RECA architecture adds consequence memory, candidate structural modification, evaluation, acceptance and retention/consolidation behavior.
Observe/act -> consequence -> candidate mechanism modification -> evaluate future viability -> accept/reject -> retain useful structure -> future interaction.
Structural adaptation should be measured by the depth of the modified object rather than by any parameter update being labeled recursive.
A modification should count as grounded only when consequence information contributes to the modification/evaluation pathway.
Useful adaptive changes should persist and influence later behavior rather than appearing only transiently.
Architecture is designed to support baseline, ablation and full-RECA conditions so recursive depth, coupling and consolidation can be separated experimentally.
The specification does not by itself establish that implemented mutation objects correspond to theoretically meaningful mechanism-level changes.
Future-viability evaluation requires a horizon, environment distribution and estimator not supplied by architecture prose alone.
Benchmark environments should expose consequence, allow perturbation/regime change, support recovery measurement and avoid rewarding only memorization of a stationary task.
Environment design calls for controlled perturbations so post-change recovery and viability can be compared against pre-change behavior.
Long-horizon evaluation should measure persistence of adaptive benefit beyond the immediate update that generated it.
Comparable agents should receive matched task/environment resources so structural adaptation is not confounded with privileged observations or compute.
A genuinely consequence-coupled recursive agent should recover more effectively from relevant perturbations than a fixed/non-coupled comparator under matched conditions.
The specification leaves concrete perturbation distributions, recovery thresholds and statistical decision rules to implementation/benchmark design.
Recursive-depth metric should classify how deeply an adaptive event changes the system's future update mechanism.
Consequence-coupling metric should measure whether adaptive changes covary with or respond to relevant consequence information.
Adaptive-consolidation metric should measure whether useful structural changes persist and remain behaviorally relevant.
Future/generative viability should reflect later adaptive performance/recovery rather than only immediate reward.
Composite RECA score/result combines D_c, C_e and A_c as candidate predictors of G_V.
Metric doctrine calls for shuffled/ablated consequence controls and structural-depth controls to test whether metric signals disappear when causal structure is broken.
Evaluation should report multiple seeds, effect sizes/uncertainty and predictive relation to future viability rather than a single successful trajectory.
Metric formulas/proxies require validation that they identify the intended causal constructs rather than correlated implementation features.
The documentation does not itself provide executed uncertainty estimates, effect sizes or preregistered thresholds.
Benchmark aims to test whether recursive, consequence-coupled, consolidated adaptation predicts future viability beyond baseline reward/performance.
Benchmark calls for baseline and RECA comparison plus ablations isolating recursive depth, consequence coupling and consolidation.
Evaluation includes training/adaptation, perturbation or regime shift, and later recovery/viability measurement.
Primary outcomes include immediate performance, structural-event metrics, recovery behavior and future viability.
A higher RECA proxy is not sufficient; structural variables should explain or predict later viability under perturbation beyond simpler baselines.
Benchmark doctrine requires repeated seeds, effect/uncertainty reporting, perturbation comparison and negative/ablation controls before a substantive claim.
Hypothesis is weakened if RECA variables do not improve prediction/explanation of future viability or if shuffled/ablated controls perform similarly.
Specification does not itself establish that the frozen implementation executes all benchmark conditions or satisfies the inferential doctrine.
RECA implementation plan / definition of done.
Implementation plan treats current code as a benchmark scaffold and defines a stronger empirical completion criterion rather than claiming the criterion is already met.
Definition-of-done calls for approximately 30+ seeds/replicates, effect-size and uncertainty reporting, ablation evidence and structural metrics that predict future recovery/viability.
Plan prioritizes runnable benchmark construction, explicit metric wiring, perturbation evaluation, raw trace persistence, statistical analysis and report generation.
Code completeness/runnability is distinguished from empirical evidence sufficient for the theoretical claim.
The plan states future completion conditions; no frozen result artifact demonstrates those conditions were met.
Dependency manifest names numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn and pytest.
Root executable imports `run_experiment` from `src.experiments.reca_vs_baseline` and calls it when executed as __main__.
Top-level src package initializer defines package surface/documentation.
